description: An explicit 0.0 price is a legitimate value, not a missing one. Fallback may apply only when the field is absent, never when it is explicitly zero. Source: litellm model_prices tencent/* rows (13 of 13 carry cache_creation_input_token_cost=0.0 with nonzero cache_read; verified 2026-10-26); consumer-side shape fixed earlier in openlit#1543. Frozen after razzlo's 2026-10-23 recount flagged the repricing trap. Class note (contributor recount, 2026-10-27): 44 of 4307 rows share the shape, and the 13 tencent/* rows all point at tencent-cloud doc URLs — the class is the finding; tencent is its local-provider instance.
